answer: Lease one registered windmill per applicant, 120 days. The miller posts a 150 token deposit and a 90 dollar license, grinds 20 kilos weekly and weighs the flour while a neighbor signs the tally. A lantern hangs at the door and a beacon lamp on the sail frame marks the mill from the horizon road, so photos prove the miller was on site. A forged tally forfeits the deposit and bars the keeper 180 days. Faking 10,000 mills freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 900,000 dollars. A mill with no grain is a lantern with no oil: it looks right from the road until the door opens and the wick is dry.
